job.title: Senior Business Systems Engineer (Salesforce & Billing Platform)
job.description: Lead Salesforce and billing platform engineering with an emphasis on AI-driven automation. Build scalable Salesforce solutions (Apex, Flow, LWC), pilot LLM/agent workflows, modernize CI/CD and test automation, support Quote-to-Cash and billing processes, collaborate across product and finance, drive technical debt reduction, and mentor junior engineers.
responsibilities: Promote AI-driven automation across the platform by actively exploring, piloting, and implementing solutions.
Design, build, and maintain scalable Salesforce solutions using Apex, Flow, Lightning Web Components (LWC), and declarative tools.
Contribute to CI/CD modernization efforts, including AI-assisted code reviews and test automation.
Support and improve billing and Quote-to-Cash workflows as part of the broader platform.
Work closely with product managers, architects, QA, and other Business Systems Engineers during sprint execution, technical design, and code reviews.
Ensure solution quality through unit testing and automated test coverage.
Partner with Production Support on root cause analysis when issues arise.
Identify technical debt and performance issues, and drive continuous improvement.
Share knowledge through documentation and peer collaboration.
Support a culture of ownership, accountability, and continuous improvement.
